اصطبروا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَرُوا (iṣṭabarū) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
# اِصْطَبِرُوا (iṣṭabirū) /isˤ.tˤa.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَبَرَ (iṣṭabara)
